acceptanceCriteria: All workspace package versions and Cargo.lock entries resolve to 0.2.33.

Current release and architecture documentation in all three languages names v0.2.33 as the current installation baseline and uses v0.2.33 archive examples; historical v0.2.32 facts remain immutable and explicitly historical.
Source version consistency, documentation acceptance, governance integrity, release policy, and complete workspace tests pass before publication.

The reviewed release workflow is configured to build and publish v0.2.33 only after the hosted gates, with manifest, SHA256SUMS, SBOM, provenance, and artifact smoke evidence, and to hand off post-release acceptance to WI-301.
The hosted release workflow is configured to publish v0.2.33 only after the reviewed PR and all pre-publication gates pass; its handoff declares the post-release acceptance successor boundary.

This Work Item closes only the release-preparation boundary; public artifact installation, current-repository upgrade, and adopter/N-1 acceptance are mandatory successor WI-301 activities and are not claimed here.
goal: Prepare and review the v0.2.33 release route; hand off immutable public-artifact installation and adopter acceptance to WI-301.
intent: Prepare v0.2.33 from reviewed main after WI-299 corrected adopter finalization base binding, and establish an auditable handoff to post-release WI-301.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: public release artifact and adopter acceptance
scenarioCoverage.expected: The published v0.2.33 artifact passes immutable manifest, checksum, installation, repository, and adopter acceptance checks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the declared source and hosted release gates, then execute the public adopter and N-1 acceptance harnesses using only downloaded release artifacts.
